title: Prime Video to Host “Obsessed Fest” Fan Event in June, Shares First Looks of Upcoming YA Screen Adaptations (Exclusive)
summary: The one-day immersive fan event, featuring anticipated titles ‘Every Year After,’ ‘The Love Hypothesis,’ ‘Elle,’ ‘Off Campus’ and more, will offer fans exclusive first looks, appearances from casts and creators and fan focused access to the talent and creators.
